Additional_Factors: Undiacritized (no tashkeel), common vocabulary and simple syntax; repeated definite article 'ال' and several short function words (لم، كان، أو) which can be segmentation points for dyslexic readers.

Statement: فأنصاف الحلول دائمًا ما تجر الهزائم.
Label: EASY
Additional_Factors: Short sentence, common vocabulary, presence of hamza characters (أ, ئ) and a final tanwīn marker; clear word boundaries and punctuation. No heavy orthographic crowding.

Statement: نزلوا في الطريق للراحة وتناول الطعام،
Label: EASY
Additional_Factors: Common everyday vocabulary and clear word boundaries reduce difficulty; presence of clitic stacking (ل+ال) and conjunction/suffixes (و، وا) adds segmentation load.

Statement: أنا من طوكيو .
Label: VERY_EASY
Additional_Factors: short sentence with common words and a proper noun (Tokyo); minimal visual clutter; no tashkeel

Statement: لن أتركك أيها المخادع
Label: EASY
Additional_Factors: No full tashkeel present. Visible hamza on alif (أ) and presence of clitics (particle لن, suffix -ك, definite article ال, vocative أيها) which slightly increase segmentation demands.

Statement: القرد يلتقط الموز من الشجرة.
Label: EASY
Additional_Factors: Common everyday vocabulary and simple syntax; absence of tashkeel (no vowel marks); moderate local dot clustering (e.g., ي ت ق ش ج) but good word spacing.

Statement: اجتمعت العائلة مسا... تكتب الهمزة على شكل  (أ) أ  (ب) إ  (ج) ئـ  (د) ء
Label: MODERATE
Additional_Factors: Multiple small hamza glyphs as answer choices (أ، إ، ئـ، ء) increase visual confusability; parentheses, ellipsis and mixed symbols add visual clutter; task requires fine orthographic knowledge of hamza placement rather than lexical access.

Statement: ثم ذهبت به إلى الحمام وألبسته حلة من الملابس الفاخرة وأكلت أنا وإياه
Label: MODERATE
Additional_Factors: Pronoun/gender ambiguity and moderately complex syntax with multiple clitics; otherwise common everyday vocabulary.

Statement: نستسلم لكن لا ما دمنا احيــــــــاء نـــــــرزق
Label: MODERATE
Additional_Factors: Extensive use of tatweel/kashida (elongation) inside words causing visual stretching and irregular spacing; absence of hamza/orthographic cues; punctuation missing — all increase visual noise and segmentation difficulty.

Statement: الإجابة صحيحة!
Label: VERY_EASY
Additional_Factors: Short, high‑frequency phrase; contains hamza and tāʾ marbūṭa which add minimal visual complexity; exclamation mark/punctuation only, no vowel marks.

Statement: ستظل اللغة العربية اللغة الرسمية للدولة.
Label: EASY
Additional_Factors: Short, highly frequent vocabulary and predictable syntax; repetition of 'اللغة' increases contextual support; no tashkeel; normal Arabic cursive joins but no typographic irregularities.

Statement: الدرس الأول:
Label: VERY_EASY
Additional_Factors: None significant; only a colon punctuation mark which adds minimal visual clutter. Words are high-frequency and short.

Statement: أصدقاء على الشاشة
Label: EASY
Additional_Factors: Final hamza in أصدقاء and repeated heavy-dot letter ش in الشاشة can create local visual crowding; definite article ال attached to الشاشة adds minimal segmentation load.

Statement: اليابانيون لا يأخذون إجازات طويلة .
Label: MODERATE
Additional_Factors: No tashkeel present; contains hamza/variant alifs (إ, يأ) and a mix of affixed morphemes (definite article, verbal affixes) but clear word spacing and short sentence length.

Statement: وسلم على الغريب، وافترق كل منهما عن الآخر.
Label: EASY
Additional_Factors: Short, common vocabulary and clear punctuation (comma) aid segmentation; presence of clitics (و, ال, -هما) moderately increases parsing load.

Statement: فهم كرماء.. ولن يرفضوا لك طلبًا.
Label: EASY
Additional_Factors: Short sentence with high-frequency vocabulary; one final tanwīn (طلبًا) and simple punctuation (ellipsis) which may slightly increase visual clutter but overall minimal.

Statement: ورسمها: إيهاب شاكر
Label: VERY_EASY
Additional_Factors: short phrase with punctuation (colon); contains proper names; hamza on initial alif (إ) which may add minor visual complexity

Statement: إنه في نهاية هذا الطريق .
Label: VERY_EASY
Additional_Factors: Short, highly predictable sentence with high-frequency words and clear word boundaries; no tashkeel but low lexical ambiguity; presence of definite article (ال) and attached pronoun (ـه) increases segmentation demand slightly.

Statement: فتقولين: وأنا عائدة من المدرسة..
Label: EASY
Additional_Factors: presence of hamza characters (أ, ئ) which alter local letter shapes; punctuation (colon and ellipsis) and a clustered sequence of dotted/confusable letters in the first word (فتقولين) increasing local visual clutter.

Statement: تعالَي أعرِّفكِ إلى مارجريت.»
Label: MODERATE
Additional_Factors: Partial/inconsistent diacritization (some words diacritized, others not) and a foreign proper name (مارجريت) that may have less typical Arabic orthographic familiarity; presence of punctuation/closing quote may add minor visual clutter.

Statement: أَتَعَلَّمُ مِنْ هَذا الدَّرْسِ أَنْ:
Label: EASY
Additional_Factors: Full vocalization with multiple shaddas and sukun (visual clutter). Short, high-frequency words and clear syntax reduce decoding demand. Presence of definite article assimilation (shadda) may add local visual complexity.

Statement: وأصدر القائد أوامره بالاستعداد للرحيل،
Label: EASY
Additional_Factors: presence of hamza and lam-alif ligature forms; several clitics attached (و, ب, ال, ل, ه) increasing segmentation load; otherwise common vocabulary and moderate word length

Statement: صِدْقُ الرسولِ
Label: VERY_EASY
Additional_Factors: Very short, high-frequency religious phrase; clear word boundary; diacritics present that clarify pronunciation; only one dotted letter (ق), so low visual confusability.

Statement: يَصِفُ أَساسَ التَّعامُلِ مَعَ الوالِدَيْنِ.
Label: MODERATE
Additional_Factors: presence of shadda (التَّعامُلِ) and hamza (أَساسَ) increases visual marks; full vocalization reduces homograph ambiguity but adds visual clutter for dyslexic readers.

Statement: أنا كلبٌ كيِّس وحسَّاس؛ لأنني أنتمي في الأساس إلى الثعالب.
Label: MODERATE
Additional_Factors: presence of shadda (gemination) and tanween, partial/uneven diacritization across the sentence, semicolon punctuation which may interrupt processing

Statement: فلا فرقَ مابين أني أكون
Label: MODERATE
Additional_Factors: Word segmentation: 'مابين' written as a single token (ما بين) reduces clear word-boundary cues; minimal punctuation and short context reduce top‑down cues.

Statement: رائع .
Label: VERY_EASY
Additional_Factors: Contains a medial hamza on yāʼ (ئ) which can be a minor source of orthographic complexity for some readers, otherwise none.

Statement: الأكل والبنايات والملابس ودولة كاملة مختلفة عن الدول الأخرى ، ولذلك إنها مكان ممتاز للزيارة .
Label: MODERATE
Additional_Factors: Frequent prefixed conjunction 'و' and multiple definite articles (ال) increase visual crowding; presence of hamza-on-alif forms; overall vocabulary and syntax are highly familiar.

Statement: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَاهِلُونَ قَالُوا سَلَامًا * وَالَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَامًا.
Label: HARD
Additional_Factors: Quranic orthography: dense tashkeel including shadda (gemination) increasing local visual clutter; classical/archaic register (less frequent in everyday speech); verse separator '*'/punctuation as visual distractor.

Statement: الأرنب يقفز فوق العشب الأخضر في الصباح الباكر.
Label: MODERATE
Additional_Factors: No diacritics (requires reliance on orthography/context). Multiple definite articles (ال) attached to several words increasing segmentation demands. Short, highly familiar vocabulary and simple syntax reduce difficulty.

Statement: الأميرة تلبس فستاناً جميلاً وتحمل وردة حمراء.
Label: EASY
Additional_Factors: Simple, high-frequency vocabulary and predictable syntax reduce difficulty; short words and clear word boundaries. Minor extra visual load from two instances of tanwīn (final diacritics).
